thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: release v2.14.0 -> production canary starts 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z. Job: #8421. Targets: embeddings, rerank. /cc @maya @jason

maya: holding — saw alerts from Priya about a latency spike. do not start the canary until we confirm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jason: ack, pausing the release window. can someone paste the incident link?

priya: incident thread: <https://incidents/redwood/INC-2301|INC-2301>. embeddings p99 jumped to ~1.25s since 21:35 UTC, error budget burn. believes related to last runtime change (kv cache patch).

lina: confirming — tracing shows increased serialization time in kv-cache layer after the last deploy. p50 fine, tail affected. recommends freeze + revert candidate.

maya: decision: abort canary start and mark v2.14.0 as paused for now. jason, can you coordinate rollback on prod if we need immediate mitigation?

jason: yes. propose rollback to tag v2.13.7 (last known-good). plan: (1) abort canary job #8421, (2) rollback prod pool, (3) pin upcoming release branch to avoid auto-redeploys, (4) reschedule the canary after SRE signoff.

tom: infra ok to perform rollback. runway: about 6-8 minutes for drain + warm. will coordinate capacity.

priya: starting rollback now: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --cluster=prod --service=runtime --to-tag=v2.13.7 --reason="latency spike INC-2301"`

deploy-bot: Job #8421 aborted by jason. Rollback job #8430 queued. 

deploy-bot: Rollback job #8430 started on prod pool a-1 (initiated by priya). ETA ~8m. Logs: https://builds/redwood/8430

priya: rollback completed. health checks: /health ok. p99 embeddings back to ~0.45s. small rerank error bump ~0.5% — creating bug ENG-492.

lina: nice. confirm we should pin the release branch and block any auto-rollouts. I'll update the deploy policy to require manual approval for v2.14.0 until postmortem.

jason: done: release board -> status = "paused - incident"; pinned branch `release/v2.14.0` to v2.13.7 artifacts. changed calendar entry to postponed.

carol: I'll draft a short customer-facing note: "We postponed the v2.14.0 canary due to a transient latency regression; no customer data affected. Monitoring continues." will drop in #marketing for review in ~15m.

maya: reschedule proposal: new canary window Thursday 2026-03-26 02:00-03:00 UTC, pending SRE signoff and a short regression test run. Jason, set tentative and we'll confirm by 01:00 UTC.

jason: set tentative window, added reminder and checklist: smoke tests, perf gate, subset of heavy prompts for 30m.

priya: notes: (a) correlate incoming traffic patterns around 21:30-22:00, (b) avoid bursty rerank workloads during the new canary window, (c) run small-scale KV-cache stress test before canary.

lina: plus: add a fallback route in smart-routing to divert to legacy model variant if p95 > 0.8s during canary.

maya: action items summarized: 1) release paused & pinned (jason) 2) rollback done (priya) 3) update deploy policy to manual for v2.14.0 (lina) 4) draft customer note (carol) 5) tentative reschedule 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC (jason) 6) add perf/regression checks (priya/lina).

jason: will update release notes to include the incident note and the hotfix path. pushing a short changelog entry into the release PR.

carol: customer note posted to drafts. will ping back once reviewed. :email:

maya: thanks team. if anyone sees related alerts overnight tag me and escalate. otherwise we reconvene in the morning for a brief check-in. :thumbsup:

priya: tagging ENG-492 (rerank bump) and INC-2301 in the rollback change. created follow-up tickets.

lina: if we see recurrence after next deploy we should open a postmortem; will add the postmortem doc template to the release board.

jason: closing thread for now. will re-open when we have a go for the rescheduled canary. :white_check_mark:
